files.assertionPreservation: The original test title and twelve of fourteen original expect-bearing lines are preserved verbatim. The old version truthiness check is strengthened to an actual pinned scanner --version process with nonempty output/exit zero. The original commit expectation is moved to committed.status for a nested ledger event; old cross-principal read/continuity, forgery, revocation and recall assertions remain. Upstream adds nested ancestry/receipt replay and a new process restart. Intelligence additionally adds native scoped callbacks/races and a second real C17 document test.
